---
title: "In Silico Physics Lab"
subtitle: "Discovering the laws of nature through Python simulations"
---

Welcome to **In Silico Physics Lab**—an open, ad-free learning space designed for middle and high school students to explore how physical laws work from the inside out.

Instead of only memorizing formulas, each experiment lets you:

1. **Understand the Law:** Connect physical intuition to the exact mathematical equations.
2. **See the Algorithm:** Learn how a computer turns a differential law into step-by-step motion.
3. **Run & Tweak Live Simulations:** Modify parameters and run real Python physics engines right inside your web browser.
4. **Code Locally:** Download clean, readable Python scripts to experiment on your own computer.
